# v4.4.7 current source/package qualification

This is a new current decision, separate from the exact historical pending audit,
provenance, B8/MR failures and earlier qualification records. It retains the
catalog-defined six packages, 39 commands, all video/execution dependencies and
the previously accepted supported workflow scope. It does not accept user-host
installation (LEX-14–16), unsupported providers/platforms or efficiency claims.

`qualification.json` records criterion and package/host decisions. `promotion.json`
binds original ignored evidence locations to byte-identical durable files. Raw
captures, rejected launches, failed runtime attempts and source/cache directory-mode
normalization observations are retained. Absolute paths identify actual runs;
they are not instructions to recreate that machine. Archived helper oracles retain
their original execution context. The current repository regression checks and
production acceptance validator provide the portable current validation seam.

The forty corrected-transport originals have 39 independent qualifications and
one retained unqualified E4. The separately preregistered E4-AM1 adds only the
exact omitted E3 predecessor observation and independently qualifies that one
self-contained case. It does not replace E4 or prove causality, repair efficacy,
model reliability or complete isolation. Existing valid MT1–MT3 were not repeated.
The frozen 294-run efficiency comparison remains unexecuted.

Current checks: `npm run sync:codex`, `npm run check:codex`, `npm test`, available
strict Claude validation of all six roots, then `node scripts/validate-skill-release.mjs`
from the tracked immutable candidate. Publication remains separately authorized
and must be verified from the actual release/tag/run/source. Original approval,
check execution, source review, model response, runtime, publication and installed
host acceptance prove different things.
